# molina-pond-theme

A Claude Code theme mod for the desktop and mobile apps. Molina, the pink pixel axolotl from the [Molina desktop pet](https://github.com/DeyDom001/Molina), lives in an animated pond with fish, a jellyfish, a sea turtle and a snail. Visitors drop by every few minutes. A music-box melody plays and visitors call out as they pass. The theme follows your light or dark mode, and the app colors match the pond.

## What happens in the pond

Living there: Molina on her rock, a sea turtle strolling the sand, two drifting jellyfish, an octopus, an eel that peeks out of its rock, striped fish circling an anemone, fish schools, a pufferfish that puffs up, tiny tetras, a hopping shrimp, a turning starfish and a snail, among kelp, sea grass, anemones and lily pads.

Now and then, on a timetable: an orca, a sea turtle, a manta ray and a seahorse swim through and call out; a squid jets past; a big sardine school sweeps by; a faint whale passes far behind; bubbles burst up from the sand.

## Commands

- `/pond sounds on|off`: the visitors' calls. Remembered across sessions.

The speaker button in the session's title bar controls the rest of the sound: a music-box melody at 60 BPM in 432 Hz tuning, water, bubbles, Molina's chimes when Claude is done or needs you, and a note when you click the water (low on the left, high on the right).

## As your context window fills

| Context | Molina | Pond |
|---|---|---|
| 0–24% | awake, smiling, hops now and then | a few bubbles |
| 25–49% | calm | more bubbles and plankton |
| 50–74% | sleepy, yawns | busier still |
| 75–100% | asleep, z's float up | the most glowing plankton |

A badge in the top-left corner shows the percentage in 5% steps (each change redraws the pond, so it updates in steps rather than every reply).

## Files

- `hooks/register.tsx`: colors, theme sound, visitor calls and `/pond`.
- `hooks/pond.ts`: the pond scene (SVG and CSS animation).
- `hooks/molina.ts`: Molina (from the pet's pixel arrays) and the other animals.
- `hooks/layout.ts`: where the animals are, and the visitors' timetable.
- `sounds/`: the visitors' calls.
- `tools/make-sounds.mjs`: makes everything in `sounds/`. Run `node tools/make-sounds.mjs` after changing it.
- `hooks/make-colors.js`: color helper copied from Claude Code; leave it as it is.

## Install

At the prompt of a terminal Claude Code session:

```
/plugin install molina-pond-theme --marketplace DeyDom001/molina-pond-theme
```

Answer `y` to add the marketplace, then pick a scope (user is fine). From a shell:

```
claude plugin install molina-pond-theme --marketplace DeyDom001/molina-pond-theme
```

In the desktop app, where `/plugin` does not run: click **+** next to the prompt box, then **Plugins**, **Add marketplace** with `DeyDom001/molina-pond-theme`, then **Add plugin**.

The pond shows in the Claude desktop and mobile apps; the terminal has no backdrop. Start a new session after installing.

## On, off, undo

- Off: `claude plugin disable molina-pond-theme@molina-pond`
- On: `claude plugin enable molina-pond-theme@molina-pond`
- Undo: `claude plugin uninstall molina-pond-theme@molina-pond`, then `claude plugin marketplace remove molina-pond`
